response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), ranked AS (SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS count_to_city_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY address_count DESC) AS city_rank FROM city_counts) SELECT city_id, address_count, count_to_city_average, share_of_all_addresses FROM ranked WHERE city_rank <= 10 ORDER BY city_rank, city_id
